verdict.rationale: Poly is a file-storage and notes product, so a browser clipper is a fair axis for it, but the evidence documents no official web clipper, browser extension, or highlight-capture flow. The closest item is the CLI `wget` command, which downloads a URL into Poly from the terminal. That is an adjacent building block, not a browser-based capture of articles and highlights into notes.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can clip web pages, articles, and highlights from my browser straight into my notes with an official clipper or capture flow

citations.quote: wget — Download a URL straight into Poly
